analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI at 32.5 in oversold territory, ADX at 29.5 shows sustained trend strength but directionality (-DI 33.9 vs +DI 17.4) favors downside. 5-day low at $52,000 and 20-day low at $51,065 suggest potential Higher Low pattern. With ATR at $6,939, a 1.3x ATR stop ($9,020) from entry $52,175 would be $43,155, targeting $71,200 (2.0 R:R). However, continued -DI dominance warrants holding off on buy entry.
